newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures stabilise after initial slip.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures stabilise after initial slip.

text.p: 1345 GMT - Sept bond future bounces off 128.74 support to trade unchanged. Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said first indications show public finance situation "serious", to study scope for VAT cut, repeats commitment to starting EMU on time. Pledges to honour all election promises. 10-yr OATs lag Bunds slightly. Franc weaker but steady at low of 3.3757 vs mark. Sept PIBOR also off lows, stuck at 96.52 support. *Sept 10-yr future 128.86, off 0.02. Vol 88,094. Lown 1xx.xx *5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.60 pct. Bund spread -11 bp *Sept PIBOR 96.52, off 3 bp, low 96.51.
